text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. was set to run in the Kyodo News 
Hai. Upon learning this, Katsuragi Ace 
asked her Trainer for permission to enter 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To enter in order to compete against 
strong opponents. Mr. C.B.'s reason for 
running fired her up. Wondering if that 
strong opponent might just be herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Understanding Katsuragi Ace's fighting 
spirit, her Trainer allows her to enter 
the race. It is the prelude against a 
rival she is bound to clash with again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To run with a strength that even Mr. C.B. 
would acknowledge—with that determination 
in her heart, Katsuragi Ace threw down the 
gauntlet!
